days.why: Bachata was born in the Dominican Republic, and Santo Domingo is where it is still danced in bars and on streets every night.
Mariachi bands gather every night at Plaza Garibaldi, in the historic centre of Mexico City.
Axé exploded out of Salvador's carnival blocos, and its drums still fill the streets of Pelourinho.
Jazz was born in New Orleans, and brass bands still play it on the streets of the French Quarter.

days.why: Django Reinhardt created jazz manouche in Paris in the 1930s, and gypsy jazz still fills the city's small clubs.
Rebetiko, the bouzouki music of Greece's underground, took root in Thessaloniki's taverns and port quarters.
